headerDisplay: **Step 1** — [Click here to log in with your Bosch Single Key ID](https://smarthome.authz.bosch.com/auth/realms/home_auth_provider/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=oss_residential_app&response_type=code&scope=email+offline_access+profile+openid&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bosch.com%2Fboschcam&code_challenge=iKgRlRLGEjGhoPztbIEY-g6wNAP8lE2pPqEi7Q1mBbk&code_challenge_method=S256) *(opens in new tab)*  **Step 2** — After login the browser shows `www.bosch.com/boschcam?code=…` — copy the **full URL** from the address bar.  **Step 3** — Paste it into **Authorization Callback URL** below and save.

authCallbackUrl.title: Authorization Callback URL
authCallbackUrl.description: Paste the full redirect URL from your browser here (step 4 above). Leave empty on first save. Can be removed once cameras are discovered.

cameras.title: Camera Overrides
cameras.description: Optional per-camera name and stream quality settings. Cameras are auto-discovered; add an entry here only to rename or tune a specific camera.

apiId.title: Camera API ID
apiId.description: Bosch camera UUID. Find it in Homebridge logs after first run: look for 'Camera accessory configured (Bosch ID: ...)'.

name.title: Display Name
name.description: Override the camera's name as shown in Apple Home.

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg Path
ffmpegPath.description: Full path to the ffmpeg binary. Leave empty to use the system PATH. Example: /usr/bin/ffmpeg

debugStreaming.title: Enable Debug Logging
debugStreaming.description: Log verbose ffmpeg output. Enable only for troubleshooting — it is very noisy.
